description: The device roster of a dataset: `devices.csv` at the dataset root, one row per recording device, holding device-lifetime facts — platform, display geometry, calibration and its provenance, capabilities. Referenced by the trial family's `StudyflowLog.device_id`. Run-lifetime facts (recording engine, viewing distance) stay on the run log.

tables.name: Device
tables.description: One recording device in the dataset. Shipped as `devices.csv` at the dataset root, one row per device: identity, display geometry, calibration with provenance, and capabilities. Referenced by `StudyflowLog.device_id` in the trial family.
notes: A device is reused across runs, sessions, and agents; a calibration belongs to the device. Run-lifetime facts — the recording engine (`engine_name`/`engine_version`) and the viewing distance (`screen_distance`) — live on the trial family's `StudyflowLog`, not here.
Physical lengths are centimetres (BIDS' `ScreenSize`/`ScreenDistance` use metres; divide by 100 to map).
Every participant-supplied value is optional, and refusal is recorded (`declined`), distinct from absence.

fields.name: device_id
fields.description: A unique identifier assigned to the device, used to link runs (`StudyflowLog.device_id`) to the device that recorded them.

fields.name: os_version
fields.description: Version of the operating system, free-form.

fields.name: screen_size_cm
fields.description: Physical size of the display as [width, height], in centimetres. BIDS `ScreenSize` uses metres; divide by 100 to map.

fields.name: screen_resolution
fields.description: Resolution of the display as [width, height], in device pixels (the native raster).

fields.name: screen_refresh_rate
fields.description: Refresh rate of the display, in hertz.

fields.name: device_pixel_ratio
fields.description: Ratio of device pixels to OS-scaled logical pixels (e.g., 2.0 on a Retina display).

fields.name: screen_count
fields.description: Number of displays attached to the device during the study.

fields.name: px_per_cm
fields.description: Pixel density of the display: device pixels per centimetre, as calibrated or derived. The bridge from pixel geometry to physical size.

values.description: Computed from the display's EDID physical size, plausibility-gated.
Derived from a self-reported screen diagonal plus the auto-read resolution.
The ruler calibration task (participant measures displayed lines; verified).
The card-matching task (on-screen image matched to an ISO/IEC 7810 ID-1 card; unverified).
A population prior; no measurement for this device.

fields.name: px_per_cm_measured_at
fields.description: When the `px_per_cm` value was measured or derived.

fields.name: pixel_aspect_verified
fields.description: Whether pixel squareness was verified (e.g., by asking which of several ellipses looks round). A horizontal-only calibration assumes square pixels.

values.description: Read automatically from the platform (e.g., EDID); plausibility-gated but unconfirmed.
An automatic value cross-validated by an independent estimate (e.g., the self-reported diagonal).
Measured by a calibration task (e.g., the ruler task).
The participant declined to supply or verify the value. Recorded, not left absent: "did not answer" is a different fact from "unknown".
Read automatically from the platform (e.g., EDID); plausibility-gated but unconfirmed.
An automatic value cross-validated by an independent estimate (e.g., the self-reported diagonal).
Measured by a calibration task (e.g., the ruler task).
The participant declined to supply or verify the value. Recorded, not left absent: "did not answer" is a different fact from "unknown".

fields.name: dpi_raw
fields.description: The raw pixel-density value the platform reported, before any plausibility gating — kept for audit, since platform values are wrong in known ways (e.g., Windows reports the user's scaling setting, not panel density).

fields.name: camera_present
fields.description: Whether a camera was available to the session.

fields.name: microphone_present
fields.description: Whether a microphone was available to the session.

fields.name: touch_capable
fields.description: Whether the display accepts touch input.

fields.name: input_devices
fields.description: Input devices available to the session (e.g., `mouse`, `trackpad`, `keyboard`, `touchscreen`, `eyetracker`). Individual devices producing data streams are identified per stream by `source` (see the vocabulary term).
